content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overshoot true outcomes by 2-4% due to a systematic upward bias in the 30-day horizon.", "Apply a mean-reversion correction factor of -15% to model predictions when historical volatility exceeds 8%.", "Reduce forecast confidence significantly if sentiment history shows conflicting signals between recent bullish spikes and declining price trends.", "Adjust downward by 10-12% when the last three days of sentiment are uniformly high (1.00) but prices remain flat or slightly decreasing.", "Account for a 5-day lag in market reaction to major sentiment shifts by shifting forecasted turning points earlier.", "Invert the correction logic and apply an upward adjustment if sentiment history shows sustained low values (0.00-0.33) despite rising price action.", "Reduce forecast magnitude by half when the ratio of true outcome variance to model forecast variance exceeds 1.5.", "Prioritize short-term mean-reversion signals over long-term trend forecasts during periods of high sentiment volatility."] }
